tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for participating in this interview. Today I'd like to ask you some questions about your spending habits. First, can you tell me about the recent purchase you or someone in your family made and why you decide to buy it?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您参与本次访谈。今天我想问您几个关于消费习惯的问题。首先，您能告诉我最近您或您家里人所做的一次购买吗？以及您为什么决定购买它？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. When you make a purchase, do you usually plan ahead or do you buy things spontaneously, why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：明白了。当您购物时，您通常是有计划地提前安排，还是会一时冲动购买？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some people believe that creating a monthly or weekly budget is essential for managing finances effectively. When budgeting your time or money for your next purchase, which is more important? Quality for the money or spending less over all? Why.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。有些人认为，制定每月或每周的预算对于有效理财至关重要。当您为下一次购买规划时间或资金时，哪个更重要？是追求性价比，还是总体上少花钱？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. For my final question, I'd like to ask about using apps or online tools for managing spending habits. Do you think people will increasingly rely on financial apps and tools to manage their money or will people prefer to hire professional personal managers? Explain your thoughts.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得好。最后一个问题，我想问一下关于使用应用程序或在线工具来管理消费习惯。您认为人们会越来越依赖金融应用程序和工具来理财，还是会更倾向于聘请专业的个人理财师？请说明您的想法。
tasks.title: Interview
